paragraph: Rochelle Park is a single-family market, plain and simple. Nineteen homes sold over six months at a median of $680,000, mostly three-bedroom colonials and capes with two full baths. The sale-to-list ratio is 1.058, nearly 79 percent of homes sold above asking, and the median days on market is 11. That is a real seller's market, and buyers should expect competition on the good ones. The range runs from $515,000 to $1,170,000, so the median is the number to anchor on. Monthly closings run three to five, too thin to call a trend, though medians held in the high $600,000s from March through June before a lower July print. If Rochelle Park follows the usual arc, expect volume to taper modestly through fall and thin out in deep winter.
